parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, c.name as brand_name, c.wa_access_token, c.phone_number_id,
       bd_product.content as product_info,
       bd_pricing.content as pricing_info,
       bd_objections.content as objections_info,
       bd_prompt.content as system_prompt
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN clients c ON l.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_product ON bd_product.client_id = c.id AND bd_product.doc_type = 'product'
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_pricing ON bd_pricing.client_id = c.id AND bd_pricing.doc_type = 'pricing'
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_objections ON bd_objections.client_id = c.id AND bd_objections.doc_type = 'objections'
LEFT JOIN brain_docs bd_prompt ON bd_prompt.client_id = c.id AND bd_prompt.doc_type = 'prompt'
WHERE l.id = {{ $json.lead_id }}

INSERT INTO conversations (lead_id, direction, message, message_type, sender, sent_at)
VALUES ({{ $('Extract Data').first().json.lead_id }}, 'outbound', '{{ $('Process & Score').first().json.aiResponse.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'text', 'ai', NOW())

UPDATE leads SET score = {{ $('Process & Score').first().json.newScore }}, status = '{{ $('Process & Score').first().json.newStatus }}', last_contact = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $('Extract Data').first().json.lead_id }}
